## Prototype scope (Stage 3)

**Allowed:** core gameplay, basic juice, win/lose, restart, rough levels.

**Forbidden:** store, settings, polished menus, hundreds of levels, economy, production ads.

**Content target:** e.g. 5–10 data-driven levels.
